request: Deeply analyze and implement foundation master forms, saved supplier fields, typed custom text/number fields and formulas.

changes.before: Master list fields were cut to five metadata columns.
changes.after: All item fields and saved supplier code/name/business/contact/phone/email/address are selectable; default list shows supplier name.
changes.why: A purchase supplier was stored but unavailable as a list layout choice.

changes.before: Shared item form settings used the small generic master schema, disconnected from ItemUI detail controls.
changes.after: All83 field labels/order/visibility/required/readonly and fresh-item defaults feed actual typed controls.
changes.why: The same metadata must control actual entry and persistence, not just the form preview.
changes.complexDefaults: Original array controls and defaults preserved; complex defaults are edited in the original typed input-settings UI.

changes.before: Numeric custom formulas were supported in core but did not show live results using full native item fields.
changes.after: Text/number creation, numeric reference picker, operators/functions and live readonly calculated results; core recalculates before saving.
changes.why: Users need a usable way to build and verify formulas without trusting editable computed values.

changes.before: Old list forms refer to c0..cN column positions.
changes.after: Read-only aliases map to canonical IDs and remap formula tokens, preserving saved raw JSON/order/labels until explicit save.
changes.why: Expanding the metadata catalog must not misbind old calculations or rewrite user layouts.

changes.before: Specification-mode refresh replaced a user-selected field label.
changes.after: Named-form specification labels and required markers survive mode changes.
changes.why: A built-in mode switch must respect the selected named form.

changes.before: Search ignored custom values and most detailed fields.
changes.after: All saved values and the registered supplier name are searchable.
changes.why: Custom data must be usable after saving and reloading, not only displayable.

validation.knownRepairDuringValidation: Guarded absent ItemCore in legacy minimal modal environment; preserved existing missing-custom default behavior; final spec-label repair covered by extended live-form Node scenario and focused browser recheck.

prior08815.appendText: 2026-10-24 · 0.88.15: 원본 로그인 대기만 반복하지 않도록 자체 보존 결함 수정부터 재개했다. BOM 계산 후 계정·회사·역할·입력창·저장본이 달라져도 결과가 적용되던 문제를 수정했다. 이유는 이전 화면의 결과로 다른 계정이나 창의 자료를 덮어쓰지 않도록 하기 위해서다. 신규 Node 9개·전체 브라우저 152개 통과 후 기존 운영에 배포했고, 로그인·자료 8건·양식·서버 상태·메일 보존을 확인했다. 원본 필드설정·VAT5·최소구매단위·업로드 저장 계약은 미완료이며, 다음은 주문/재고/바코드 보조창의 조회·미리보기 보호를 개발한다.
